'''Rorak 4''' was an industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] called the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] and the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']]. Rorak 4 was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Rorak 5/Legends|Rorak 5]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and was the site of the largest [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] market in the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Realspace/Legends|Space]].

==Description==
Rorak 4 was an [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Rorak system/Legends|Rorak system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']], which connected it to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Diyu]]. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route called the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] linked Rorak 4 to the world of [[Circumtore/Legends|Circumtore]]. Rorak 4 was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Rorak 5/Legends|Rorak 5]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and was the site of the largest [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] market in the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Realspace/Legends|Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The Rorak [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located within the territory controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] at least as early as the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[11,000 BBY]].<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and the area of space surrounding the planet was considered well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] by [[8000 BBY]]. The local population average of the region of space containing Rorak 4 around the year [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] ranged from 10 million to 500 million.<ref name="TEA" /> At some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] the Rorak [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Attack on the Rorak system|attacked]] by the military forces of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of the galaxy, and the [[Star/Legends|star]] system was held under the control of those invaders until at least 27 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rorak 4 was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], and published on [[August 18]], [[2009]]&mdash;which placed the planet in grid square S-12.
